title: Electricity network product catalogue, version 2
sourceDescription: Version 2, checked 25 November 2026. It corrects broken and redirected source links, updates products that have been renamed or sold (Octave Attune EAM, formerly HxGN EAM; Siemens Gridscale X Meter Data Management, formerly EnergyIP; Oracle Utilities Customer Service and Billing; Salesforce Field Service and Operations), adds capability links the vendor page already supports, and adds reviewed-candidate products for previously uncovered capabilities, including EA Technology's VisNet Connect, Reliability Apps, Capacity Apps, Invest and Astute HV Monitoring. Every new or changed claim is Pending review until a named reviewer signs it; unchanged claims keep their original review. Coverage is deliberately a first slice.
